name: LayerFilterThemes
description: Theme rail (step 1) for the LayerFilter plugin. Renders the high-level themes and emits the selected theme on the event bus. Pulls its theme list from the LayerFilter tool.

components.name: Toggle Panel ID
components.description: The id of the panel that the rail's top chevron button shows/hides via core's 'core:togglePanel' command (e.g. 'left-panel'). Defaults to 'left-panel'.
